edges: The indigenous people of the area at the time of European settlement have generally been welcomed by the Sydney people or the Eora.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Campaigners oppose the social and environmental consequences of the development at Bondi Beach.
Bondi Beach is located in the suburb of Bondi, in the Local Government Area of Waverley, seven kilometers from the center of Sydney.
Bondi Beach has a commercial area along Campbell Parade and adjacent side streets, featuring many popular cafes, restaurants, and hotels.
Bondi Beach hosted the beach volleyball competition at the 2000 Summer Olympics.

edges: One theory describes the Eora as a sub-group of the Darug language group which occupied the Cumberland Plain west to the Blue Mountains.
